title: 專案合作
description: 團隊合作與專案討論用語

sentences.en: Before we assign the remaining tasks, I think we should review the project scope to ensure that everyone has a clear understanding of their responsibilities.
sentences.zh: 在我們分配剩餘任務之前，我認為我們應該審查專案範圍，確保每個人都清楚了解自己的職責。

sentences.en: The design team, which has been working closely with the developers over the past two weeks, has finalized the user interface mockups for the new feature.
sentences.zh: 過去兩週一直與開發人員密切合作的設計團隊，已經完成了新功能的使用者介面模型。

sentences.en: Could we schedule a brief sync meeting tomorrow to discuss the blockers that are preventing us from completing the current sprint on time?
sentences.zh: 我們能安排明天開一個簡短的同步會議，討論阻礙我們按時完成當前衝刺的障礙嗎？

sentences.en: Having reviewed the pull request submitted by the backend team, I noticed several areas where the code could be optimized for better performance and readability.
sentences.zh: 在審查了後端團隊提交的拉取請求後，我注意到有幾個地方的程式碼可以優化以獲得更好的效能和可讀性。

sentences.en: The project timeline, originally estimated at six months, may need to be extended by three weeks due to the additional requirements introduced by the client.
sentences.zh: 原本預估六個月的專案時程，可能需要延長三週，因為客戶提出了額外的需求。

sentences.en: I appreciate the effort you put into the research phase; your findings have provided valuable insights that will guide our decision-making process going forward.
sentences.zh: 我很感謝你在研究階段投入的努力；你的發現提供了寶貴的見解，將引導我們未來的決策過程。

sentences.en: Since the frontend and backend workstreams are closely interdependent, we need to establish clear communication channels to avoid integration issues later on.
sentences.zh: 由於前端和後端的工作流程密切相互依賴，我們需要建立清晰的溝通管道以避免之後的整合問題。

sentences.en: The quality assurance team has identified a critical bug in the authentication module, which needs to be resolved before we can proceed with the user acceptance testing.
sentences.zh: 品質保證團隊在認證模組中發現了一個嚴重的錯誤，需要在我們進行使用者驗收測試之前解決。

sentences.en: To ensure smooth handoff between shifts, I suggest we create a shared document where each team member logs their daily progress and any outstanding issues.
sentences.zh: 為確保交接班順利，我建議我們建立一份共享文件，讓每位團隊成員記錄每日進度和任何未解決的問題。

sentences.en: Although our initial approach seemed promising, the results from the prototype testing indicate that we need to pivot our strategy and explore alternative solutions.
sentences.zh: 儘管我們最初的方法看起來很有前景，但原型測試的結果表明我們需要轉變策略並探索替代方案。

sentences.en: The product owner, who has direct access to the stakeholders, will prioritize the backlog items based on business value and technical feasibility this afternoon.
sentences.zh: 可以直接接觸利害關係人的產品負責人，將在今天下午根據商業價值和技術可行性來排定待辦事項的優先順序。

sentences.en: I would like to suggest that we adopt a pair programming approach for the most complex modules, as it could significantly reduce the number of bugs introduced.
sentences.zh: 我想建議我們對最複雜的模組採用結對程式設計的方式，因為這可以顯著減少引入的錯誤數量。

sentences.en: Given that we are approaching the release deadline, I recommend we focus exclusively on critical path items and defer any non-essential enhancements to the next iteration.
sentences.zh: 鑑於我們正接近發布截止日期，我建議我們專注於關鍵路徑項目，將任何非必要的增強功能推遲到下一次迭代。

sentences.en: The retrospective held after the last sprint revealed that unclear requirements and insufficient documentation were the primary causes of delays in our workflow.
sentences.zh: 上次衝刺後的回顧會議揭示，不明確的需求和不足的文件是我們工作流程延遲的主要原因。

sentences.en: I noticed that the shared repository has several merge conflicts that need to be resolved; could someone from the infrastructure team look into this as soon as possible?
sentences.zh: 我注意到共享儲存庫有幾個需要解決的合併衝突；基礎設施團隊的人能盡快處理這個問題嗎？

sentences.en: In order to maintain consistency across all deliverables, I have created a style guide and coding standards document that every team member should follow strictly.
sentences.zh: 為了在所有交付成果中保持一致性，我建立了一份風格指南和編碼標準文件，每位團隊成員都應嚴格遵守。

sentences.en: The integration testing environment, set up by the DevOps team last week, is now available for all developers to deploy and validate their feature branches.
sentences.zh: DevOps 團隊上週建置的整合測試環境，現在已可供所有開發人員部署和驗證他們的功能分支。

sentences.en: Rather than working in isolation on separate components, I believe we would benefit from more frequent code reviews and knowledge-sharing sessions among team members.
sentences.zh: 與其各自孤立地處理不同組件，我相信更頻繁的程式碼審查和團隊成員間的知識分享會議會對我們有益。

sentences.en: The stakeholder feedback collected during the demo session suggests that we need to simplify the navigation flow, which several users found confusing and unintuitive.
sentences.zh: 在演示會議中收集的利害關係人回饋顯示，我們需要簡化導航流程，因為多位使用者覺得它令人困惑且不直觀。

sentences.en: If we can finalize the API specifications by the end of this week, the mobile development team will be able to start building the client-side features in parallel.
sentences.zh: 如果我們能在本週結束前確定 API 規格，行動開發團隊就能同步開始建構客戶端功能。

sentences.en: The dependency on the third-party service, which has been experiencing intermittent outages, poses a significant risk to our delivery timeline that we must address proactively.
sentences.zh: 對一直經歷間歇性中斷的第三方服務的依賴，對我們的交付時程構成重大風險，我們必須主動解決。

sentences.en: I want to commend the entire team for their dedication and hard work during this challenging phase; your collaborative spirit has been truly inspiring to witness.
sentences.zh: 我想表揚整個團隊在這個具挑戰性的階段的奉獻和努力；你們的合作精神真的令人鼓舞。

sentences.en: Would it be feasible to allocate one developer from the platform team to assist us with the database migration, which is blocking our progress on the analytics module?
sentences.zh: 是否可行從平台團隊調配一名開發人員來協助我們進行資料庫遷移？這阻礙了我們在分析模組上的進度。

sentences.en: The cross-functional workshop we held last month, attended by representatives from engineering, design, and product, resulted in a much clearer shared understanding of the project goals.
sentences.zh: 我們上個月舉行的跨職能工作坊——由工程、設計和產品的代表參加——讓大家對專案目標有了更清晰的共同理解。

sentences.en: Before we commit to this architectural decision, I strongly recommend that we conduct a proof of concept to validate our assumptions about scalability and performance.
sentences.zh: 在我們承諾這個架構決定之前，我強烈建議我們進行概念驗證，以驗證我們對可擴展性和效能的假設。

sentences.en: The knowledge transfer session, scheduled for next Monday afternoon, will cover all the critical processes that the new team members need to understand before taking over the project.
sentences.zh: 安排在下週一下午的知識轉移會議，將涵蓋新團隊成員在接手專案前需要了解的所有關鍵流程。

sentences.en: Since we are distributing the workload across multiple time zones, establishing overlapping working hours for real-time communication is essential for maintaining project momentum.
sentences.zh: 由於我們在多個時區分配工作量，建立重疊的工作時間以進行即時溝通對於維持專案動力至關重要。

sentences.en: I have updated the project board with the latest task assignments and deadlines; please review your items and flag any concerns about the estimated completion dates.
sentences.zh: 我已用最新的任務分配和截止日期更新了專案看板；請檢視你的項目並標記對預估完成日期的任何疑慮。

sentences.en: The lessons learned from this sprint, particularly regarding scope creep and communication gaps, should be documented and shared with the entire organization for future reference.
sentences.zh: 從這次衝刺中學到的經驗——特別是關於範圍蔓延和溝通落差——應該被記錄下來並與整個組織分享以供未來參考。

sentences.en: As we onboard the new contractor who will be joining our team next week, I will prepare a comprehensive onboarding guide that covers our tools, processes, and coding conventions.
sentences.zh: 在我們迎接下週加入團隊的新承包商時，我將準備一份涵蓋我們工具、流程和編碼規範的全面入職指南。
